info.title: Valendata REST API
info.description: Trigger Skills, manage Workflows, retrieve Runs, and stream structured results from any language using JSON over HTTPS.

post.description: Execute a published Skill by ID and receive strict JSON output enforced against the Skill's defined output schema.

skill_id.description: The unique identifier of the published Skill to execute. Skill IDs follow the format skl_...

parameters.description: Key-value map of parameter values to pass to the Skill. Parameter names must match those defined in the Skill's configuration.

post.description: Run a published Skill and wait for the rows. Put the Skill's inputs at the top level of the JSON body (or in the query string). The body keys `browser_type`, `proxy_config`, `profile_id`, `scrape_mode`, `max_pages`, and `version` are run settings, not inputs. Inputs are checked against `input_schema` before anything runs. If too many of your runs are in progress, this returns 429 with `Retry-After` instead of waiting.

post.summary: Create a Skill from a task
post.description: Record `task` in a cloud browser from `start_url` and publish it as a Skill. Answers at once with a creation id; poll `GET /v1/skill-creations/{creation_id}`. Up to 2 recordings in progress per account; needs at least 10 credits. Recordings cannot sign in to websites.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The same key from the same account returns what it already started.

202.description: Creation started (or the existing one, for a repeated Idempotency-Key).

get.description: Where a creation is: `queued`, `recording`, `validating`, `ready` (run `run_url`), or `failed` (`error` says why). Only the account that started it can read it.
The Skill with its `input_schema`, `output_json_schema`, `reliability`, versions, and fast path. A public Skill needs no credentials. A private Skill returns 404 to anyone who may not run it.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug of the Skill.

get.description: Success rate and repairs over the last 20 runs, when it last worked, the last failure kind, the live recipe version, and each route's health. Public for public Skills; private Skills return 404 to anyone who may not run them.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug of the Skill.

post.description: Validate the inputs, start the run, and answer at once with a `run_id`. If your account is at its limit of runs in progress, the run queues. Poll `GET /v1/runs/{run_id}` or pass `webhook_url`.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug of the Skill.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The same key from the same account returns what it already started.

202.description: Run queued (or the existing one, for a repeated Idempotency-Key).

get.description: Status while it runs, and the result once it is done. Rows are in `rows`. Readable by whoever started the run and by the Skill's owner.
The secret your webhook deliveries are signed with. Each delivery carries `X-Valendata-Timestamp` and `X-Valendata-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<timestamp>.<raw body>")>`.
Every recipe version, newest first, with which one is live and which is pinned. Needs the right to run the Skill.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug of the Skill.

post.description: Make version `n` the live recipe. The restore is saved as a new version. Owner or workspace editor only.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug of the Skill.

put.summary: Pin or unpin a recipe version
put.description: `{"version": n}` pins the Skill to version `n`; `{"version": null}` unpins it. While pinned, automatic repairs are saved as candidate versions and do not change what runs. Owner or workspace editor only.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug of the Skill.

post.description: Change a Skill in one of three modes. `fix` (default): relearn it from a plain-English hint about where the data is. `add_fields`: capture new fields you describe in plain English; the request is first compared with the Skill's fields, so a re-worded duplicate is merged into the existing field and an unclear one comes back as a question. `relearn_details`: rebuild how the Skill opens each result (its per-row detail steps), for when the site changed or detail fields come back empty. Every mode runs on a cloud browser, saves a new recipe version and checks it with a short run (up to 5 rows). The new version stays live only if it is better; otherwise it is kept as a candidate and the previous recipe stays live. Owner or workspace editor only; drafts allowed. One improvement at a time per account and per Skill, up to 6 an hour, at least 10 credits to start. Charged to the caller.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key. The same key from the same account returns what it already started.

202.description: Improvement started (or the existing one, for a repeated Idempotency-Key).

409.description: The Skill is already being improved.

get.description: Where an improvement is: `queued`, `working`, `validating`, `done` (`result` and `improved` say whether the new version is live; `changes` shows each field before → after; `details` shows new, merged and unclear fields) or `failed` (`error`). The account that started it and anyone who can edit the Skill (its owner or a workspace editor) can poll it; anyone else gets 404.

The Skill's full change history, newest first: every fix, added field and re-learn by anyone allowed to edit it (the owner or a workspace editor), from any channel (`source`), plus past Refine and Re-learn entries imported from before (`imported: true`, `result: applied`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, 1–50.

200.description: The Skill's change history, newest first.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key with the `vd_sk_` prefix. Create keys from Settings, API Keys in the dashboard.

SessionAuth.description: Session token (JWT) obtained by calling `POST /api/auth/login` with your email and password.

detail.description: Error message. Usually a plain string; may be a structured object for some errors.

error.description: Why the run failed, otherwise null.

cost_usd.description: The same cost in US dollars.

cost_final.description: False while the run's cloud browser time is still being billed (the browser is billed when it closes, which can be after the run answers). `credits_charged` is then only what has been billed so far. True once nothing more will be charged.

cost_estimate_credits.description: `credits_charged` plus an estimate of the browser time still being billed, at the current browser rate. Equal to `credits_charged` once `cost_final` is true.

drifted_fields.description: Fields that look wrong on this run, with the reason.

unverified_fields.description: Fields not yet proven to be read correctly, with the reason.

rejected_values.description: Values removed because they did not appear on the page: `{field, value, reason}`.

truncated_sections.description: Sections that had more data than this run collected: `{section, clicks}`.

scrape_mode_used.description: `flash` or `deep` for skills that support scrape modes, else null.

recipe_version.description: The recipe version this run replayed.

heal_kind.description: The repair that became the recipe during this run, if any.

tier_timings.description: Every route tried: `{tier, ok, seconds, reason}`.

diagnosis.description: Present when the run failed or a field came back on fewer than half the rows.

parameters.description: Parameter definitions accepted by the Skill.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema that defines the structure of the `data` array returned by every run.

steps.description: Workflow step definitions in order. Each step includes its type (`agent`, `code`, `http`, `transform`, `dfuse`, `skill`), name, and configuration.

task.description: What the skill does, in plain words.
task.example: Search for dentists in Austin and list them

start_url.description: The http(s) page the skill starts on.

name.description: Skill name. Derived from the task when omitted.

inputs.description: Up to 5 inputs, each mapped to the example value the recording uses. Each value must appear in what the browser types or opens. Inferred when omitted.

output_fields.description: Up to 25 columns, as `{name: description}` or a list of names. Inferred when omitted.

skill_id.description: Set once the recording is saved.

slug.description: Set once the recording is saved.

idempotent_replay.description: True when an Idempotency-Key matched an existing creation.

diagnosis.description: On failure: what was tried and example hints.

success_rate_20.description: Percent of the last 20 finished runs that worked.

heals_20.description: How many of the last 20 runs needed a repair.

SkillContract.description: The Skill's public details plus its typed contract. Other public fields (description, parameters, output_schema, category, tags, ratings, and so on) are also returned.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the inputs. Unknown keys are refused.

output_json_schema.description: JSON Schema for the run result, including each row.

fast_path.description: For example `fast path: direct HTTP, ~0.3s`. Null when the skill always uses the browser.

tiers.description: Per route: attempts, ok, success_rate, typical_seconds, status.

parameters.description: Accepted as another name for `inputs`.

max_results.description: Max rows; 0 returns the whole list.

browser_type.description: `remote`, `extension`, `local_profile`, or `none`. Omit for the Skill's saved setting.

proxy_config.description: Region for this run (country code, `random`, or `none`).

profile_id.description: Browser profile to use for this run.

scrape_mode.description: `deep` or `flash`, for Skills that support it.

webhook_url.description: Public http(s) URL that receives the finished run as a signed POST.

version.description: Recipe version to replay. Omit for the pinned or live one.

rows.description: The rows, once the run has finished.

cost_usd.description: The same cost in US dollars.

cost_final.description: False while the run's cloud browser time is still being billed (the browser is billed when it closes, which can be after the run answers). `credits_charged` is then only what has been billed so far. True once nothing more will be charged.

cost_estimate_credits.description: `credits_charged` plus an estimate of the browser time still being billed, at the current browser rate. Equal to `credits_charged` once `cost_final` is true.

drifted_fields.description: Fields that look wrong on this run, with the reason.

unverified_fields.description: Fields not yet proven to be read correctly, with the reason.

rejected_values.description: Values removed because they did not appear on the page: `{field, value, reason}`.

truncated_sections.description: Sections that had more data than this run collected: `{section, clicks}`.

scrape_mode_used.description: `flash` or `deep` for skills that support scrape modes, else null.

recipe_version.description: The recipe version this run replayed.

heal_kind.description: The repair that became the recipe during this run, if any.

tier_timings.description: Every route tried: `{tier, ok, seconds, reason}`.

diagnosis.description: Present when the run failed or a field came back on fewer than half the rows.

secret.description: Your signing secret. Keep it private.

actions.description: Recorded steps that changed, were added, or were removed.

changed.description: False when the restored recipe was already live.

Diagnosis.description: Why a run, validation or creation came back short, and hints that could fix it with `POST /v1/skills/{slug}/improve`.

missing_fields.description: Fields fewer than half the rows came back with.

summary.example: phone: found on 0/5 rows — tried the result cards

mode.description: What to do. `fix`: relearn the Skill from a hint about where the data is. `add_fields`: capture new fields described in `feedback`. `relearn_details`: rebuild the steps that open each result, for when the site changed or detail fields come back empty.

feedback.example: The phone is on the details page — click the place name, the panel opens, the number is next to the phone icon.
feedback.description: Plain English, 3–2,000 characters. Required for `fix` (what is wrong and where the data really is) and `add_fields` (the new fields to capture, for example "also capture the star rating and review count"). Optional for `relearn_details`, as a note. A request without it in `fix` or `add_fields` mode gets `422`.

fields.description: Up to 10 field names. For `fix`: the output fields the hint is about; omit to use the last run's missing fields, or the fields the hint names. For `add_fields`: the names of the new fields; omit to let Valendata name them from `feedback`. Ignored for `relearn_details`.

example_input.description: Inputs for the check run. Omit to use the recorded example.

source.description: Where it was started: `api`, `mcp`, `assistant` (Igris), `web` (the web app), `brain` (the workflow Brain chat), or `imported` (a past Refine or Re-learn from before improvements were unified).

started_by_name.description: The name of the person who started it.

strategy.description: `fields`: relearn where the fields live. `rerecord`: redo the steps.

diagnosis_after.description: The check run's diagnosis, when fields are still missing.

improved.description: True: the new version is live. False: kept as a candidate, the old recipe restored.

result.description: Short verdict. `running`: not finished. `improved`: the new version is live. `kept_old`: not better, so the old version stayed live. `no_change`: nothing needed changing. `failed`: see `error`. `applied`: imported from the old Refine history, applied without a check run.

imported.description: True for a past Refine or Re-learn entry imported into this history.

merged.description: Requested fields that were re-worded duplicates of existing ones, merged into them.

ambiguous.description: Requested fields that were unclear and were not learned. Answer `question` and send a new request.

diff_summary.description: One line on what changed in the recipe.

engine_note.description: Any extra note from the engine.

recipe_version.description: The live version when it ended.

candidate_version.description: The version kept but not made live.

BadRequest.description: Bad request. The request body is malformed, missing required fields, or invalid.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized. The Authorization header is missing, malformed, or the credential is invalid or expired.

NotFound.description: Resource not found in your Workspace.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this API key, too many runs in progress, or too many recordings in progress. Check the `Retry-After` header when present.

InternalError.description: Internal server error on Valendata's side.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden. You may not run or change this Skill, or it is not published or active.

PaymentRequired.description: Not enough credits to start. `detail` includes `current_balance` and `required`.

Unprocessable.description: Invalid request. For bad inputs, `detail` is `{message, errors, allowed_inputs}`.
